title: frontend-probe output
description: The one JSON object a blind frontend-probe reader returns after seeing one first-viewport image and nothing else: two sentences on what the page is, what it does and for whom. assets/wave-fragments/critique.js passes this schema, unchanged, as the agent() schema of each probe call (a test keeps the copies equal).

what.description: What it is, in a few words.

unclear.description: true when the image does not let the reader tell.
